name: CreateModelService

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP whitelist.

The value 127.0.0.1 indicates that no external IP addresses are allowed to access the instance. After the instance is created, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86928.html operation to modify the IP whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单。

127.0.0.1表示禁止任何外部IP访问，您可以在实例创建完成后调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86928.html接口修改IP白名单
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The list of AI nodes used for model deployment
parameters.help_zh: 模型部署使用的AINode节点列表
parameters.name: ai_nodes

parameters.help_en: The model parameters. This parameter is not supported
parameters.name: model_params
